title: What counts as work at height?
lines: Work at height isn't just roofs and cranes.
Anywhere you could fall more than two meters counts as work at height.
A ladder, scaffolding, a roof, a basket or a confined space are all included.
And each one has its own training.
Not sure what fits you? Call, and we'll explain in two minutes.
